Subject: Premium response & escalation packaging for Redwood — quick questions

Marissa,

Thanks for the demo yesterday — team liked the throughput and the routing fallbacks. Before we move to procurement, we need to firm up a few items around your premium support packaging so we can scope budget. High level asks:

- Can you confirm uptime tiers and how credits are calculated (daily vs monthly)?
- What are your target response times for P1/P2/P3 under each tier?
- How does escalation coverage work across APAC/EU (we need 24/7 P1 coverage globally or a clear paid add-on)?
- Any discounts available for a 2-year committed spend?

We’ll loop in Procurement but wanted the technical/ops answers first.

Thanks,
Alex Nguyen
Head of Platform Reliability
BrightCart

--
BrightCart contact: procure@brightcart.com

From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
To: Alex Nguyen <alex@brightcart.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 09 Jan 2026 12:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Premium response & escalation packaging for Redwood — quick questions

Alex — great to hear the demo resonated. Short answers up front, then Ben and I can follow with a concrete price/commit proposal and a one-pager.

- Uptime tiers: 99.9%, 99.95%, 99.99% (monthly measurement window). Credits are prorated monthly and capped per SLA schedule; we calculate credits as a percentage of monthly invoice tied to impacted model routes.
- Response times: P1 (Sev A) target 30 minutes, P2 (Sev B) target 2 hours, P3 (Sev C) target 8 business hours — these are the default for our 99.95 and 99.99 bands.
- Escalations: 24/7 P1 coverage is included in the 99.99 tier. For 99.95 we provide business-hours primary with an on-call rotation that covers nights for global customers; full 24/7 global is an add-on option.
- Discounts: we typically provide multi-year (2x/3x) discounts for committed spend; Ben will include a model.

I attached a short options summary (Brightcart_SLA_Options_v1.pdf). Can we set a 30min sync next week to walk through numbers and procurement asks?

Cheers,
Marissa Cole
Director, Solutions — Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
Attachments: Brightcart_SLA_Options_v1.pdf

From: ben_carter@redwood.com

Date: Sat, 10 Jan 2026 10:15:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Premium response & escalation packaging for Redwood — pricing sketch

Alex — following Marissa’s summary, here’s a sketch of pricing/packaging we typically propose. Numbers are illustrative; will get firm once we confirm commit level and route volumes.

Option A — Standard (99.9%)
- Monthly credits: up to 5% cap
- Response: P1 1h, P2 4h, P3 1 business day
- Escalation: business-hours routing, on-call weekdays
- Indicative: $6k/mo retainer + usage

Option B — Business-critical (99.95%)
- Monthly credits: up to 10% cap
- Response: P1 30m, P2 2h, P3 8 business hours
- Escalation: 24x7 P1 on-call (shifted across regions), 12x5 for P2
- Indicative: $18k/mo retainer + usage

Option C — Mission-critical (99.99%)
- Monthly credits: up to 20% cap, faster SLAs
- Response: P1 15m (hotline), P2 1h, P3 4 business hours
- Escalation: dedicated on-call pod, guaranteed 15min paging
- Indicative: $40k/mo retainer + usage

Discounts: 10% off retainer for 1-year prepaid, 20% for 2-year commit (applies to retainer only). We can trade a steeper discount for minimum committed throughput or a revenue floor.

Attachments: Commit_Tiers.xlsx — has modeled retainer vs usage scenarios and examples for regional failover add-ons.

If these look in the ballpark, Marissa and I can prepare a clean quote and T&C addendum for procurement/legal to review. Jordan, can you confirm the escalation runbook / SLA wording we’d attach?

-Ben
Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales — Redwood Inference

Thanks — this is helpful. A few follow-ups before we show to Procurement/Legal: 

1) Regional failover: we operate in NA + EU + APAC. Does the "regional failover add-on" include cross-region standby capacity or just routing? If standby capacity, how is it billed?
2) On-call escalation hours: can you confirm which parts of the world are covered by the included 24/7 P1 for the 99.99 tier — is it PST-centric or truly global? We need calendar-based guarantees for APAC morning coverage.
3) SOC 2 / evidence: would you attach the SOC 2 report or the control matrix as part of the SLA pack?

Procurement is already on the thread (procure@brightcart.com) — they’ll need a numbered quote and a DocuSign path if the terms look OK. Also putting Legal in for redline expectations.

—Alex

Subject: Re: Premium response & escalation packaging for Redwood — operational clarifications

Alex/Ben/Marissa — jumping in with ops detail to make Procurement’s life easier. Answers below, pulled from our rollout playbook. Also adding Jordan for escalation-runbook confirmation.

1) Regional failover: the add-on we referenced includes both smart routing and the option to reserve cold-standby capacity in a target region (charged as a % of committed retainer + nominal warm-up fees). Billing model is: 10% of the monthly retainer for the standby reservation + usage for any warmed capacity. If you need synchronous hot-active cross-region mirroring we treat that as a bespoke infra SLA (higher cost) — happy to scope.

2) 24/7 P1 coverage for 99.99: this is global and backed by a follow-the-sun on-call rotation. Guarantee language references UTC timestamps and includes explicit calendar windows for APAC (we guarantee a P1 page within the SLA window irrespective of customer timezone). For 99.95 we provide near-24/7 but with a target of hands-on coverage during NA/EU daytime and on-call handoffs for APAC (we can add guaranteed APAC overlap as a paid option).

3) SOC 2: we attach the SOC 2 Type II report summary and a control matrix for procurement. I’ve put the standard security pack in the SLA folder; legal may request the full report under NDA.

Next steps:
- Ben: finalize the quote numbers with the 2-year commit row showing the 20% retainer discount for their expected throughput.
- Marissa: schedule a 30–45m procurement + legal review next week; suggested slots are Tue/Wed mornings Pacific.
- Alex: confirm whether BrightCart wants the standby capacity reserved for APAC — that will change the quote.

Attachments referenced: SLA_Rollout_Schedule.gdoc (timeline & runbook), Brightcart_SLA_Options_v1.pdf (options recap).

Thanks,
Tessa Morgan
Head of Customer Ops — Redwood Inference
T: +1 415-555-0198
